bankAndFlow.browser: Verified account and status filtering, search/reset, date selection, refresh persistence, drawer Escape/focus restoration, real decision evidence reads, and bank-to-human-inbox deep links even with Answered selected. No financial actions taken.
bankAndFlow.responsive: Bank and Finance flow checked at 320px through desktop in light/dark; no page overflow, clipped transaction text or browser errors.
bankAndFlow.flow: Stage selection works by keyboard, persists in URL, and links to Bank, Team, Inbox, Ledger, Memory and Activity. Counts use existing run queries.
bankAndFlow.designLint: Static: 0 FAIL, 0 REFLEX, 0 WARN. Rendered: 0 FAIL, 0 WARN; 39b waived for large account and stage selectors containing real records.
bankAndFlow.independentReview: Resolved date spacing on the cash chart, wrapping/accessibility of transaction names, and access to journal decision evidence.
bankAndFlow.figma: Native Bank & cash 14:154 and Finance flow 14:255 in existing file; snapshot reference, not automatic synchronization.

preservation.views: Original seven destinations retained; Bank & cash and Finance flow added
preservation.data: Existing Convex queries, scenario hash, gateway semantics and WebMCP tools retained
preservation.disclosures: Full ask bodies and evidence now in review drawer; historical records under Answered; operating counts under Simulation activity
preservation.ledger: Latest 60 entries as before, with full chain count and explicit limit; all trial balance accounts remain available

limitations: Browser tests used local Convex and deterministic simulation, not a deployed environment.
Figma is a native editable reference snapshot, not an automatic two-way sync with React.
The journal query still returns the most recent 60 entries; CSV exports the currently filtered records.
Bank data is a complete-run simulation read model. It is not a real bank connection and would need aggregation/pagination for large production datasets.
